notes:
Same access route as Bestsellers (direct HTTP fetch, no block). Discovered via the site's own header dropdown menu group titled '値下げ商品から探す' (Browse discounted items), which lists 4 children: 値下げ商品 (sale_all), アウトレット商品 (outlet-all), BAZAR商品 (bazar), 店頭展示品 (display_model). The site's separate top-level category-accordion tree (/pages/category_list) ALSO has its own first-level node literally titled 'アウトレット商品' (Outlet Products) whose only children are 'Francfranc BAZAR' (a blog/editorial page, not a PLP) and a 'すべてのBAZAR商品' link to /collections/outlet (currently 0 products, a stale link -- the live BAZAR listing is at /collections/bazar, 391 products, reached via the header menu instead). This confirms the site's OWN taxonomy places BAZAR under an Outlet/Clearance heading. sale_all (og:title/meta 'SALE ALL', 1290 products) was checked and EXCLUDED per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule: it is a generic, undifferentiated discount page with no outlet/clearance/final-sale/end-of-line wording anywhere in its title or meta -- a textbook generic-Sale exclusion, not a clearance page. /collections/outlet (the accordion's own dead link) is empty (0 products) and dropped. Verified via product-ID-set comparison that the 3 rows below are mutually disjoint listings (0 overlap between bazar & outlet-all, 0 overlap between bazar & display_model, 0 overlap between outlet-all & sale_all) -- i.e. genuinely different product sets, not aliases of one another, so all kept as separate rows rather than merged. sale_all does share 72 products with bazar (of bazar's 391) but sale_all itself remains excluded as generic per the rule above. No Furniture/Lighting/etc.-level Clearance sub-structure exists (BAZAR page itself links to no further child collections; sitemap-listed bazar_towel_osusume / bazar_staffosusume_bargain handles are not linked from the live bazar page and appear to be old orphaned tag pages, not a real exposed hierarchy) -- so BAZAR, Outlet and Display Model are emitted as 3 flat parallel rows, not a group.
